ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT dated as of Joty IO,2007,betweenLESREALTYGROUP LLC, a New York limited liability company having an office at 241 West 37th Street, 3?d Floor, New York, New York 10018 ("Developer"), and LUDLOW 161 REALTY ASSOCIATES LLC, a New York limited liability company having an office at 270 Lafayette Street, Suite 405, NewYork,NewYork 10012 ("Owner"). WITNESSETH WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of the fee tile to a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, known as and by (i) the street address 161 Ludlow Street,NewYork,NewYork,and (ii) the Tax Lot Number 35,Block 412 (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as “Lot A”or “Owner's Land", and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” attached hereto and made a part hereof; said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof as permitted hereunder, being hereinafter referred to as the “Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Owner's Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of the fee title to a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, known as and by (i) the street addresses176-184 OrchardStreet and 169-171 LudlowStreet,NewYork,NewYork,and (ii) the Tax Lot Numbers 4, 5, 6, 7, 30 and 31, Block 412 (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as“Lot B"or“Developer's Land", and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" attached hereto and made a part hereof; said existing buildings and improvements, together with any alterations thereto built on Developer's Land, being hereinafter referred to as the "Developer's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements together with Developer's New Building, as herein defined, being hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Developer's Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer has acquired or will acquire development rights with respect to, or fee simple title to, additional parcels (the “Additional Parcels") such that Owner's Land, Developer's Land, and the Additional Parcels are contiguous and, pursuant to the Declaration hereinafter referred to, constitute a single “zoning lot” under Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, Developer intends to demolish the Developer's Building on Developer's Land and/or the Additional Parcels, and to construct a new building on Developer's Land (herein called the"Developer'sNewBuilding"); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the Developer's New Building will contain more floor area than now is available for use on Developer's Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedures available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for combining Owner's Land and Developer's Land (and any Additional Parcels) into a single zoning lot for the purpose of making available the Excess Zoning Rights (hereinafter defined)for utilization in connection with the construction and maintenance of Developer's New 7/6/2007 1:04 PM 127463.00401/6557720v.2

Building, and Owner is willing to make such Excess Zoning Rights available to Developer in perpetuity; WHEREAS, Owner is willing: (a) to limit to 9,111.5 square feet the number of square feet of floor area that Owner may include and maintain in Owner's Building, (b) to restrict itself from constructing any additional floor area on Owner's Building that otherwise might be permitted, and (c) to make the Excess Zoning Rights available to Developer; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing a Declaration of Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in the definition of the term “zoning lot" in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot") from Owner's Land,the Additional Parcels, Developer's Land, and such other parcels as may be included therein. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, and other good and valuable hereby agree as follows: 1. The following terms used herein shall have the meanings and definitions as hereinafter set forth: (a)“Zoning Resolution" shall mean the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork effective December 15,1961,as amended from time to time. accordance with the Zoning Resolution, that are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which the zoning lot is located; and (i) the inclusion of any under the Zoning Resolution and that may be authorized to be developed by the New York City Planning Commission or other appropriate agency of the City of NewYork. (c)“Reserved Development Rights"” shall mean the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by the Owner's Building as of the date hereof. (d)“Excess Zoning Rights" shall mean the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Owner's Premises that are in excess of the Reserved Development Rights. (e)References to “bulk", “floor area", “floor area ratio", “zoning lot", ascribed to such terms inSection12-10 of the ZoningResolution. 2.Prior to or simultaneously herewith, Developer has delivered to Owner a written certification of its architect (the“Architect's Certification") certifying that the square footage of the floor area of the Excess Zoning Rights is 2,207.5 square feet and the square footage of floor area of the Reserved Development Rights is 9,111.5 square feet, which is comprised of 7,552.6 square feet of residential floor area and 1,558.9 square feet of commercial floor area. 2 127463.00401/6557720v.2
